Today is the one-year anniversary of a bunch of hypocrites co-opting #MeToo and trying to turn it into their vehicle.

Tarana Burke will never be erased in my heart, nor will Anthony Rapp, Gabrielle Union, Terry Crews, or anyone else speaking from the heart about sexual abuse.

@kazweida Umm, the actual founders of #metoo have always welcomed male survivors. Terry Crews, Anthony Rapp, Brendan Fraser, etc. Tarana Burke has always stood with all survivors. It’s only the people co-opting it that pretend it’s purely for women.
@chriswpete @kazweida #MeToo has always been about everyone being harassed and victimised— please don’t let anyone tell you differently. Your pain matters.
